$comment: The WP5 native profile: one dedicated server and one matching native test
client, both running the same one-map FFA arena the browser slice runs.
scripts/arena_server.py derives every command line from the declarative
fields below and refuses this file if the committed argument lists differ,
so what the census observes cannot drift away from what is recorded here.
The profile is additionally bound to arena/game-profile.json and to
content/pack-recipe.json: the game directory, map, package, frag limit and
the bots themselves are the browser slice's, not a second set of numbers.
The one deliberate difference is bot skill. The browser slice is played by
a person and uses skill 3; the census client is driven blind from a script
and would spend a session respawning rather than playing, so its bots run
at the engine's lowest skill. Bot skill changes how the game plays, not
what the protocol sends: it adds no message type, no command and no field.
runtimeBaseCopyrightFiles is the number of per-package copyright files the
pinned runtime base carries. The baseline's runtime-base record obliges
arena-web to preserve them, and preservation is checked by comparing the
built image with the base — a comparison that would pass just as happily if
both sides silently dropped some, which is exactly what a `find` without
-L does here (two of the base's documentation directories are symlinks).
Pinning the count makes that regression fail instead of passing quietly.

cvarNotes.cl_allowDownload: 0 makes an attempted media download a visible failure rather than a silent fetch; WP5 must show that none is attempted.
cvarNotes.com_basegame: The same standalone game directory the server and the browser slice use.
cvarNotes.headmodel: ioq3 code/client/cl_main.c defaults it to sarge, which is retail Quake III data; CG_NewClientInfo then fails to register DEFAULT_MODEL and drops the client (code/cgame/cg_players.c).
cvarNotes.in_nograb: The census client runs on a virtual X server; grabbing the pointer there is pointless and would only add input noise.
cvarNotes.model: The same reason as headmodel, and the same player presentation the audited pack packages and the browser slice uses.
cvarNotes.name: A stable player name, so the server log and the census evidence identify the one human-slot client by name rather than as UnnamedPlayer.
cvarNotes.net_enabled: 1 is IPv4 only, so every observed datagram belongs to one address family.
cvarNotes.r_customheight: A small deterministic render size for the virtual display.
cvarNotes.r_customwidth: A small deterministic render size for the virtual display.
cvarNotes.r_fullscreen: 0 keeps the client inside the virtual display's own geometry.
cvarNotes.s_initsound: 0 because the census container has no audio device; sound has no effect on the wire.
cvarNotes.sv_pure: 0 mirrors the server: the QVMs are loose files beside the pack.

cvarNotes.bot_enable: Svcmd_AddBot_f returns immediately when it is 0 (ioq3 code/game/g_bot.c).
cvarNotes.com_basegame: Not baseq3. FS_CheckPak0 leaves com_standalone at 0 for ioquake3's own base game and the engine then refuses to start without the retail paks (code/qcommon/files.c). Any other directory name selects standalone operation.
cvarNotes.dedicated: 1 is LAN dedicated. 2 would send heartbeats to the public master servers, which is an explicit WP5 non-goal (code/server/sv_main.c SV_MasterHeartbeat).
cvarNotes.net_enabled: 1 is IPv4 only, so the census observes exactly one address family.
cvarNotes.net_port: The UDP port the census captures; PORT_SERVER (code/qcommon/qcommon.h).
cvarNotes.sv_maxclients: Slots for the test client and the bots.
cvarNotes.sv_pure: Load-bearing: FS_FindVM only considers a loose vm/*.qvm while fs_numServerPaks is 0 (code/qcommon/files.c), and the QVMs are written beside the pack rather than inside it.
cvarNotes.timelimit: The arena profile of content/pack-recipe.json: no time limit.
